title: Cancellation, Refund and Signing Terms Sheet — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
The cancellation and request-signing terms of the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) are uniform across the six tiers.

| Tier | Signed cancellation request required | Federal Policy Fee and probation surcharge refundable on a pro rata or current-term refund | Refund rounding per component (USD, half-up) | Voluntary backdating allowed (calendar days) | Mortgagee protection after notice (calendar days) | Authorized signer required on requests |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Condominium Unit | yes | no | 0.01 | 0 | 30 | yes |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Manufactured Building | yes | no | 0.01 | 0 | 30 | yes |
| NFIP General Property Form – Other Residential Building | yes | no | 0.01 | 0 | 30 | yes |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Building | yes | no | 0.01 | 0 | 30 | yes |
| NFIP RCBAP – Two-to-Four Unit Condominium Building | yes | no | 0.01 | 0 | 30 | yes |
| NFIP RCBAP – Five-or-More Unit Condominium Building | yes | no | 0.01 | 0 | 30 | yes |

- **Signed request.** A cancellation needs a signed cancellation request from an authorized signer of the named insured.
- **Fees on pro rata or current-term refunds.** The Federal Policy Fee and probation surcharge do not come back on a pro rata or current-term refund, with the scoped exception for a cancellation refund set out under the parameter meanings below.
- **Rounding — 0.01.** Each refunded component is rounded half-up to the cent.
- **Backdating — 0 days.** A voluntary, mortgage-payoff or private-replacement cancellation may take effect no earlier than the date the signed request is received.
- **Mortgagee protection — 30 calendar days.** A cancelled or non-renewed policy stays in force for the mortgagee only for 30 days after Tidemark notifies it.
- **Authorized signers.** Requests on the policy must be signed by an officer, partner, owner or association board officer on the authorized-signer list.

## Parameter meanings

- Whether a cancellation needs a signed cancellation request from an authorized signer of the named insured; boolean.
- Whether the Federal Policy Fee and probation surcharge come back on a pro rata or current-term refund; boolean. *Scoped exception:* For a cancellation refund whose current term and the term before it together carry at most one premium-bearing endorsement and at most one re-rate credit, each counted by its risk premium entries, and only for such a refund, the Federal Policy Fee and probation surcharge of a term that began after the cancellation took effect are returned in full, while those of the term in which a cancellation under current term full or pro rata takes effect stay fully earned; for a cancellation refund whose terms carry more than one premium-bearing endorsement or more than one re-rate credit, and for every other Federal Policy Fee and probation surcharge, the Federal Policy Fee and probation surcharge are fully earned under current term full and pro rata.
- Rounding applied to each refunded component (half-up); USD.
- How many days before the date the signed request is received a voluntary, mortgage-payoff or private-replacement cancellation may take effect; calendar days.
- Days a cancelled or non-renewed policy stays in force for the mortgagee only after Tidemark notifies it; calendar days.
- Whether requests on the policy must be signed by an officer, partner, owner or association board officer on the authorized-signer list; boolean.
